correctness.rationale: One-node SLQ outputs 2 log(m(1±r t)) with fair signs, so exact mean bias B(t)=log((1−r²t²)/(1−r²)) and variance U(t)^2/N. Derivative sign governed by H(t)=U/(rtB), strictly increasing from 2/B0 to infinity. This proves unique interior minimum only when N>2/B0, no interior maximum, worst endpoints switching at (logκ/B0)^2 with all equality cases; trace MSE is exact across every orientation, integer N and distinct SPD eigenvalues. Independently evaluated finite two-sign distribution, variance and endpoint inequalities; finite checks do not prove continuous result.
